title: Hoshino Ichika — Take Your Time〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. Which is why you need to assign yourselves a leader in order to play while all feeling the same thing...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And Honami's going to be that leader...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, she does seem like the perfect person.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She's gonna be the leader and the conductor! That's so cool...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, what do you need us to do?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You came here for our help, yes?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! How did you know?!
We haven't even said anything yet!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It was written all over your faces.
Honami's stepping up, so you feel that you need to as well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I guess we shouldn't be surprised.
So...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: While Honami's training with Mr. Shindo, we were hoping that we could do the same.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes! I win!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, my scissors!
I switched 'cause I thought you were going to throw paper!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You still get to go second.
I mean, look at me. I lost immediately during the first round.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, I'll start us off.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was thinking that we could also do some training while Honami's working with Mr. Shindo.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, wait...!
That's what I was gonna say!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Me too...
Well, looks like we didn't need to play rock paper scissors.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I knew it. We were all thinking the same thing.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, so... Instead of just waiting for her to come back, you'd like to prepare in a way that you'll be ready to play with her, yes?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, so we'd like to practice with another drummer while Honami's busy with her training.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Someone who can lead us if possible...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We all know how to play the drums, but if you need one of us to lead...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO's the best candidate!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would you mind doing a huge favor for us?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not at all, I'd love to!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shiho
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika, stop. Again, you're losing momentum because you're spending so much energy on seeing what everyone else is doing.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know... I had a feeling that's what was happening.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Can we try that again?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, how'd I do that time?
I thought I had a pretty good groove going...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, you sounded a lot more Sakki compared to when you guys started!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But you also rushed ahead a few times.
You need to strike a better balance somehow.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
I definitely went a bit too hard there.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, I'm also to blame.
I hesitated a little a few times...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Ichika, about that last part.
You should try to be gentler, like you're trying to comfort someone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I agree.
Especially since it's about...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why don't we stop here for today?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone...
I think you've all improved quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We have? Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still... I know I'm supposed to keep up my momentum, but it's so hard to pull off.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Even though we've been doing it to some extent already.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, it feels only natural that you'd slip up here and there since more is being expected of you now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She's right. Which is why it's important to not let any mistakes get the best of you. Just keep pushing forward.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Plus, you know what you need to do now. All that's left is to execute.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're looking forward to doing this again tomorrow, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, likewise.
